plain_text: Your Daily Debrief for Monday, May 18 — 1 meeting reviewed. Key actions on TLW funnel, HB LLM monitoring, and automated reporting.
sections:
*📅 Today's Coverage: 1 meeting reviewed*

>*Hiring Leads Standup* — 8:30 AM PDT
>Attendees: Fadi Rizk, Dana Lobo, Matan Chen Zion, Jatin Bhandari, Ray Sandza, Nelson Tang, Jeff Gombos, Usman Zafar

*🎯 KEY DECISIONS MADE TODAY*

*1. TLW Campaign — Hold & Monitor, Then Pivot if Needed*
• *Decision:* Give the current TLW scan campaign a few more days before making changes. End-of-month timing is expected to drive a natural uptick in engagement.
• *Rationale:* Top-of-funnel is low (222 scans) but the funnel itself is healthy — 81% CTR on initial CTAs is strong. The main problem is volume, not conversion.
• *Your logic:* Busy SMB owners are likely to scan near end-of-month when bills are top of mind. Rushing to change the experience before that natural inflection point could muddy the signal.

*2. Verification Bypass for May 20 Email Send*
• *Decision:* Explore adding a special URL parameter to skip verification for email campaign links (May 20th send).
• *Rationale:* 60% of users drop off at the verification step — likely because they perceive it as a sign-up flow. Email targets are already verified owners, so verification is redundant and friction-adding.
• *Your logic:* You pushed for this as a cost/benefit trade-off. Even if some employee scans slip through, the conversion gain outweighs the risk for this channel.

*✅ YOUR ACTION ITEMS*

*Immediate (Today):*
• ☐ *HB LLM Dashboard Check* — Analyze applicant flow rates and screener metrics from Friday onward. _(Good news: you already confirmed no unusual screener drop-offs since May 15.)_
• ☐ *Cross-Team LLM Check* — Ping other product teams to see if they're also seeing post-OpenAI-token-refill outages. If yes = systemic. If no = localized/misconfigured monitor.

*This Week (Wed/Thu priority):*
• ☐ *Notion Doc Review* — Jatin sent you a Notion doc with gaps to fill before his Wednesday exec check-in and Thursday leadership presentation. Review and confirm the ask makes sense.
• ☐ *Automated Reporting Sub-Agent* — Nail down the content and cadence for your Monday morning metrics sub-agent. Then sync with Jatin + Cindy to handle the deployment/plumbing (he has the infrastructure ready — don't reinvent it).

*Pending/Watching:*
• ☐ *By Thursday* — If TLW scan volume hasn't spiked, begin planning an SDR outreach campaign targeting non-converting scanners.
• ☐ *Matan to check with Kayla* — Confirm whether a URL parameter can technically bypass verification for the email send without breaking the post-verification flow.

*👀 THINGS TO WATCH*

*TLW Funnel Metrics:*
• 222 total scans (top of funnel — concerning)
• 81% click-through on initial buttons (strong ✅)
• 41% complete the full flow (acceptable given friction)
• ~60% drop at verification step (the main problem)
• Avg completion time: 6 min 4 sec

*HB LLM Status:*
• Hourly 7-minute error bursts since Friday's OpenAI token depletion incident
• Engineering hasn't found root cause yet — Jatin raising with the team Tuesday
• Your screener data looks clean — no unusual patterns since May 15 ✅

*💡 STRATEGIC CONTEXT*

You made a smart call today pushing back on removing verification entirely — instead finding the middle path (email-specific bypass). That preserves the fraud protection for QR-code scans while removing unnecessary friction for the highest-intent channel (direct email).

The automated reporting initiative is overdue — Jatin has plumbing ready that you shouldn't rebuild. The real value is in your prompt/content design, not the infra. Get that aligned this week.

Jatin needs your Notion doc input *before Wednesday* — don't let that slip. His exec presentation depends on it.

*You're in good shape. Solid standup. Go crush it. 💪*
